home.hero.title: Lift for Upliftment: A Beacon of Hope for Aspiring Doctors from Underprivileged Backgrounds
home.hero.description: Lift for Upliftment (LFU) is a Pune-based NGO dedicated to breaking down financial barriers in medical education. Founded in 2015 by passionate medical students from B. J. Medical College, LFU provides free, high-quality coaching for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) to bright, deserving students from underprivileged and tribal backgrounds. This transformative initiative empowers aspiring doctors to overcome their circumstances, successfully pursue a medical career, and achieve their dreams of serving their communities.
home.hero.mid.title: Our Impact in Medical Education

home.hero.mid.description.line1: LFU's primary program is its intensive and free NEET coaching. The organization meticulously selects students based on their academic merit and socio-economic background. Here are some of our key achievements:

home.hero.mid.second.line2: Our comprehensive NEET coaching program ensures that talented students from underprivileged backgrounds receive the academic support they need to crack the highly competitive medical entrance exam. Through expert mentorship and quality education, we're creating a new generation of doctors who will serve their communities with dedication and compassion.

home.hero.mid.feedback.title: Share your experience with us
home.hero.mid.feedback.line1: We value feedback from our students, volunteers, and supporters. Please take a moment to share your thoughts and help us improve our NEET coaching program and support services.

home.hero.bottom.title: Join Our Mission
home.hero.bottom.description: Volunteering with Lift for Upliftment is a rewarding way to make a difference in the lives of aspiring doctors from underprivileged backgrounds. Join our team of dedicated volunteers and help us continue to provide free, quality NEET coaching to deserving students.
home.hero.volunteer.title: Become a Volunteer Mentor
home.hero.volunteer.description:
Ignite a Dream: Become a Volunteer Mentor

Your journey and knowledge can be the spark that ignites a future in medicine. We are seeking dedicated medical professionals, ambitious students, and inspiring educators to help us forge the next generation of healers. For every bright student from an underprivileged community with the passion to succeed, there are immense barriers standing in their way. By offering your expertise—whether teaching crucial NEET subjects, providing one-on-one mentorship, or sharing invaluable career guidance—you become the pivotal force that helps them overcome those odds. You won't just be a tutor; you'll be a role model, a guide, and a testament to the power of giving back, directly shaping a future doctor who will uplift their community.
